top_3_failure_patterns.description: When background darkness prevented col_samples calibration, the pipeline fell back to standard_table_cols['creditors'], which are the physical column coordinates of FTX. Because IMedia has completely different column coordinates (Name at x=0.036 vs FTX x=0.067; Address at x=0.329 vs FTX x=0.255; City at x=0.713 vs FTX x=0.643), all 39k fields suffered IoU=0.
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Detect the IMedia creditor schedule format from header text and project cells into true IMedia column rails (Name: [0.036, 0.28], Address: [0.329, 0.65], City: [0.713, 0.81], State: [0.816, 0.85], Zip: [0.858, 0.95]).

top_3_failure_patterns.description: FTX table pages contain 71 vertical slots, but multi-line addresses consume 2 slots instead of 1. Uniform linear interpolation drifts by 1-4 rows as the page proceeds, dropping bounding box IoU below 0.50.
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Dynamically budget 71 vertical slots across page records by detecting 2-line address blocks from token heights.

top_3_failure_patterns.description: Raster horizontal lines slice through fine numeric/text characters (e.g. zip codes, suite numbers), causing standard n-gram token retrieval to return zero candidates.
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Apply CLAHE contrast normalization and morphological horizontal line suppression before OCR retry on unresolved cells.
